slice: merge close e201490d..origin/main (PR #202) -- the one receipt for every golden leaf the merge moved

supersedes.expected-golden-diff-merge-certification: The same claim under its first name. That name sorted before expected-golden-diff-wave2-statbuff.json, whose coupled_exact pairs this merge moves again, so the certification block was folded into this file rather than left beside it -- one receipt for one merge (R-17).

landed_against.rule: R-17 -- the merge landed against the three committed baselines plus this allowlist, and the three were re-captured once, at the merge close, in the integration commit R-32 reserves for them. This receipt declares the readings that re-capture landed; it moves no baseline itself.

filename_note: The name sorts after expected-golden-diff-wave2-statbuff.json, expected-golden-diff-a2.json and expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-rearm.json on purpose, for the reason wave2-statbuff's own filename_note gives: tests/test_golden_snapshot.declared_exact_moves folds every receipt's coupled_exact map together with dict.update over the sorted receipt names, so the last name to claim a key answers for it. Those three receipts claim nineteen per-attacker totals at pairs this merge moves past, and each pair below carries that receipt's own 'new' as its 'old', so the chain from the first claim to this one is unbroken and none of those receipts is edited.

pair_golden.shape: champion_baselines / item_sweep / registered_champion_fights keep all 670 entries: nothing was added to or dropped from the population. The 1347 new paths are main's per-slot certification fields -- skillshot +345, area_damage +321 and cc_reviewed +244 are 910 of them and carry no number at all, and the remainder are atom_id / ferocity / focus / source rows. 251 of the new paths hold a number and 4 numeric paths leave, which is the whole of numeric_leaves' move; the 774 numeric leaves that changed value did so on paths that already existed. The largest per-champion groups among them are Poppy 50, Kennen 37, Camille 37, Akshan 36, Xin Zhao 36, Jhin 36, Viego 36, Jinx 34, Azir 34, K'Sante 33.

coupled_golden.shape: 21 scenarios, unchanged. view_tag +1071 and disposition +1071 are one pair per newly published leaf; event_count +544, reason +519, source +379, kind +354, cc_kind +297 and skillshot +274 are the rest of main's publication. 4512 new paths hold a number, 28 numeric paths leave, and 17 shared paths flip between null and a number (11 gaining a time, 6 losing one) for a net +5 -- the flip set is death_time / first_death_time only, which is the survival side of the re-pricing. The numeric moves concentrate in immolate_active_bruiser_roster 615, crit_onhit_carry_roster 346, swing_term_armed_carry_roster 264, cleaver_bloodsong_roster 226, catalyst_roster 90 and mandate_abyssal_curse_roster 75.

coupled_exact.shape: Fifteen per-attacker totals over six scenarios: every committed total that a closed receipt already claims and that this merge moved outside the pair that receipt landed. Four keys an earlier draft of this receipt claimed are gone from it, because the Lulu gating below put them back inside their predecessor's pair -- hexoptics_basic_amp_carry's Lulu outgoing and Aatrox incoming, lethality_window_assassin_roster's Lulu outgoing and swing_term_armed_carry_roster's Lulu outgoing all read exactly what expected-golden-diff-wave2-statbuff.json declared, so that receipt answers for them and this one must not.

why_each_moved: Four causes, all of them main's. (1) hp-scaled parts are now priced at their own landing instant, with the walk and the pair engine agreeing -- 247 leaves over nine champions (Viego, Veigar, Xin Zhao, Jinx, Akshan, Jhin, Dr. Mundo, Seraphine, Kog'Maw). (2) Veigar's Shadowflame leaves vanish outright rather than moving, because R no longer over-kills and the execute threshold it amplified is never crossed. (3) Pets and summons act while their caster is disabled (cast_while_disabled on the damage rows), and control is resolved after damage within an instant rather than before it, which reorders every ledger holding a control event. (4) Patch data is main's 16.16.1 against this branch's 16.15, which is why champions no slice touched still move. Two merge-resolution fixes landed before the final capture and are inside every figure above: Lulu's W control event is gated on lulu_whimsy_target, so the ally Lulu in the carry rosters no longer both grants herself the cached attack speed and polymorphs every enemy -- that is what raises crit_onhit_carry_roster's main/incoming to 3794.0 and lowers swing_term_armed_carry_roster's main/outgoing to 1373.7; and Eclipse and Muramana are certified as zero-proc where they arm nothing.
certification_decisions: Main's calculator-mechanics certification publishes fields this baseline predates: per-event cc_kind / skillshot / event_precision / cast_id / target_id on the damage rows, the typed resource_ledger section, and the survival row's certification fields (action_downtime, crowd_control_*, cleanse*, projectile_defense*, guardian, permanent_bonus_health_events, spell_shield*).
Every claimed leaf is absent_to_value: the baseline holds no value for it, so no committed number moved. A leaf that MOVED is not claimed here and still fails its pin.
how_to_reproduce: 'python scripts/golden_snapshot.py compare scripts/golden_baseline.json' and the same against scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json report zero differences on this tip, because the re-capture landed; the readings declared here are the ones it landed. The pair and coupled counts above were measured by walking the JSON leaf paths of 'git show HEAD:<baseline>' against the committed file, and the coupled_exact pairs are the committed scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json read key by key against the pair each key's predecessor receipt declares.

known_consequence.threshold_defense_coverage: RESOLVED before this receipt settled, and kept here because the measurement is the evidence the gate was right. On the first merged tree crit_onhit_carry_roster -- the coupled set's only holder that absorbs a Lifeline shield of its own -- absorbed none: the ally Lulu's ungated polymorph kept both enemies from acting past 0.25s, the holder took 1585.6 rather than 2313.5 on a 2399 pool and Immortal Shieldbow's 30% threshold was never crossed, so tests/test_golden_snapshot.py::TestDeferralFamilyCoverage::test_the_carry_roster_prices_the_families_it_covers was red on a real loss of coverage rather than on a stale pin. Gating W's control event on lulu_whimsy_target retired the cause: the holder now takes 3794.0, crosses the threshold and absorbs its own shield, and the check is green. The four exact keys this receipt no longer claims are the same fix read from the other side.
